description:
Check what a client account can actually receive, before promising anything.

Reports whether the location has a blog site, an author and a category (all three
are REQUIRED by the blog post endpoint and none can be created through the API),
and whether the store is reachable.

Worth running first: 'publish a blog post' fails with a bare 422 when the blog has
no author, which reads like a permissions problem and is not one.
name: site_targets
